claim.claim-text: 1. A flavor encapsulation product comprising a soluble tapioca flour composition; wherein:
2. The product of claim 1, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition comprises an insoluble fiber content ranging from 0.5 to 1 wt%.
3. The product of claim 1 or 2, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition has a dextrose equivalent ranging from 5 to 18.
4. The product of claim 1 or 2, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition has a dextrose equivalent ranging from 8 to 15.
5. The product of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition is filtered.
6. The product of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition has a viscosity ranging from 1 to 10 cP at 25 °C and 10% dry solids.

7. The product of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition has a particle size distribution wherein 90% of particles have a size of 350 microns or less and 50% of particles have a particle size of 150 microns or less.
8. The product of claim 7, wherein 10% of particles have a size of 40 microns or less.
9. The product of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition comprises a particle size distribution wherein 100% of particles have a size of less than 1 micron.

10. The product of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition comprises a particle size distribution wherein 100% of particles have a size of less than 0.5 microns.
11. The product of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the soluble tapioca flour composition is substantially soluble in water.
